title: Verbatim: What Is a Photocopier? | Op-Docs
summary: A New York Times Op-Docs short in which actors perform a real legal deposition transcript. A lawyer gets tangled in an absurd argument with a county employee about what counts as a photocopier, in a dispute over fees for public records.
why: Commenters share it as a funny, memorable example of evasive depositions and of obstruction over public records requests.

quote.text: The New York Times did an amazing reenactment from transcripts of the legal deposition
